title: SourcedNorm
description: ITIP archetype — a Norm ascription whose statement is sourced from a legal/regulatory authority text. Extends Norm with legal provenance (source, operationalizes). All Norm fields (structure, qualifier, applicability, assertion, toleranceMode, temporal fields) are inherited — not redefined. Source: ITIP (domain archetype for regulatory model sourcing).

source.description: Legal provenance — traceability chain to the authoritative legal text.

operationalizes.description: Reference to the parent SourcedDirective this Norm operationalizes (by title).
